The '''Director's office''' were the offices of the [[Director of Republic Strategic Information Service]] and were located in the [[Heorem Complex]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
